key_concepts: Some objects give off light and are light sources.
Light sources can be natural or artificial.
Natural light sources give off light on their own.
Artificial light sources are made by people.
Flashlights, lamps, and candles can be used as light sources during a blackout.
Light is needed to see objects.
Without light, objects in a dark space cannot be seen.
Light travels from a source to objects.
Light reflects from objects to the eyes, enabling sight.
Blocking the path of light prevents it from reaching a surface.
